capabilities: Open any Markdown file as an interactive mind map in a split pane
Parse Markdown headings and lists into hierarchical mind map nodes
Embed mind maps in notes with mindelixir code blocks
Auto-refresh the mind map when the source file changes
Choose the filename or first H1 heading as the root node
extras: README includes a TODO list (node copy/paste, reverse editing of code blocks, images in mind maps), so some features are planned but not yet available.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view Markdown headings and lists as an interactive mind map diagram.

relations.evidence: transforms your markdown documents into interactive mind maps using Mind Elixir

summary: Mind map plugin that turns Markdown files into interactive Mind Elixir mind maps in a split pane or inline code blocks.
